acceptance.given: A migrated fixture has explicit before and after owner-specific authority fields.

oracle.expected: The migration comparison reports identical owner-specific authority fields before and after validation.
forbidden: Owner-specific authority fields drift between before and after states.
Validation discards or replaces owner-specific authority fields.
oracle.observable: Field-level before/after comparison output from the migration-fixture validation.

acceptance.then: The migrated fixture validation preserves the owner-specific authority fields.
acceptance.when: During migrated-fixture validation, compare the explicit before and after states.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the migrated-fixture authority comparison with an injected owner-specific authority drift or omission and require validation failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate migration fixtures while preserving owner-specific authority fields.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve the existing migration-fixture and authority-field formats.

slice_hint.state_transition: The migrated fixture moves from explicit before/after input states to a validation result proving authority-field preservation.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validation output records equal before/after owner-specific authority fields with no replacement or loss.

acceptance.then: The inspected package remains unchanged after validation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the validator immutability test against an inspected-package snapshot and fail when content, hashes, or file state differ.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Keep inspected packages read-only during validation and verify this with before/after snapshots.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve the existing package input and read-only validation interface.

slice_hint.state_transition: The inspected package moves from a pre-validation snapshot to an identical post-validation snapshot.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Content, hash, and file-state comparisons show no package mutation.
